normalization_note: Google Trends normalizes search interest to a 0-100 scale relative to the peak within the queried timeframe and geography. Values from different queries are independently normalized and not directly comparable in absolute terms.
limitations: Values represent relative search interest, not absolute search volume.
Each query is independently normalized by Google.
Low-volume search terms may return zero or no data.
Google may sample data differently across requests.
Results may vary slightly between collection runs.
